notes.title: Linux port available now and Mac music fix!
notes.content:
Dear players, 

We are presenting Linux Wine port of the game. 
Alt+Tab might produce undesired behavior on some systems, beware. 

We also have fixed music in Mac version of the game.
Feel free to leave comments, questions, bug reports on discussion forum. 

Thank You and have a good play!  ːsteamhappyː

notes.content:

Here is a little update for You.
It will fix keys binding and music in Windows version of the game.
I would like to express my gratitude to [b][url=http://steamcommunity.com/id/cyanic]cyanic[/url]
[/b] for finding the cause of music bug.
Feel free to leave comments, questions, bug reports on discussion forum. 

Thank You and have a good play! ːsteamhappyː
